title: Firewall rule modal action-target validation
acceptance_criteria: Create Rule modal rejects `jump` action submissions without a jump target.
Create Rule modal rejects `offload` action submissions without a flowtable target.
Edit Rule modal rejects `jump` action submissions without a jump target.
Edit Rule modal rejects `offload` action submissions without a flowtable target.
When action targets are unavailable (no custom chains/flowtables), selectors and submit are blocked with clear guidance.
UI shows clear error messages for missing action-dependent targets before API calls.
Frontend typecheck/build/runtime smoke pass after modal validation changes.
assumptions: Action-specific target requirements should be enforced client-side to prevent avoidable failed writes.
Backend contract remains unchanged; this slice is UX validation only.
Browser e2e smoke remains out-of-gate on this host until Playwright shared libraries are installed.

tasks.notes: Added action-dependent target validation for jump/offload in create/edit submit handlers.
Validated via frontend gates (`tsc`, `build`, `smoke:runtime`) after modal validation changes.

commands.test: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s build && npm run -s smoke:runtime
